title: HPA MONON TRAILER, INC.: MONON/BRAKES (12 affected)
summary: AIR BRAKE FITTINGS AND AIR BRAKE HOSES ON THE BRAKE ACTUATORS CAN BREAK BECAUSE OF INSUFFICIENT VERTICAL CLEARANCE UNDER THE AIR RESERVOIR.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/HANDRAILS (2,117 affected)
summary: AN ITEM WORN BY A CHILD, SUCH AS A LONG DRAWSTRING, SASH, OR BACKPACK/BOOKBAG ACCESSORY, CAN BECOME CAUGHT ON THE FATENERS THAT SECURE THE HANDRAIL SUPPORT TO THE HANDRAIL.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTO TRANSMISSION (40,000 affected)
summary: THE PARK PAWL ABUTMENT BRACKET HAS A SHARP EDGE WHICH CAN CAUSE THE PARKING PAWL TO HANG UP AND NOT ENGAGE THE PARK GEAR.  THIS WOULD ALLOW THE VEHICLE TO MOVE EVEN THOUGH THE GEAR SHIFT INDICATOR SHOWS THAT THE VEHICLE IS IN PARK.

title: IL LI INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.: PHILLIPS/FMVSS NO. 108 (146,500 affected)
summary: THE PIN AREA OF THE REPLACEMENT BULB IS NOT WATER TIGHT.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT (224,000 affected)
summary: NOTE: DRIVER'S SIDE (LEFT) PASSIVE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY.    THE RAIL OF THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT CAN WEAR SUFFICIENTLY SUCH THAT THE CABLE WHICH RETRACTS THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY WILL BECOME JAMMED IN THE RAIL RENDERING THE SHOULDER BELT INOPERATIVE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT (224,000 affected)
summary: NOTE: PASSENGER SIDE (RIGHT) SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY.    THE RAIL OF THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT CAN WEAR SUFFICIENTLY SUCH THAT THE CABLE WHICH RETRACTS THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY WILL BECOME JAMMED IN THE RAIL RENDERING THE SHOULDER BELT INOPERATIVE.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/FMVSS 301 - FUEL TANK (28 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES BUILT ON GM P3 CUTAWAY CHASSIS.  THE SCHOOL BUS, WHEN TESTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH FMVSS NO. 301, EXCEEDED THE ALLOWABLE FUEL SPILLAGE AS SPECIFIED BY THE STANDARD.  THE FUEL TANK WAS PUNCTURED AS A RESULT OF THE IMPACT OF THE MOVING BARRIER.

title: Starcraft RV: STARCRAFT/BED ASSEMBLY (1,061 affected)
summary: THE BED ASSEMBLY CAN BYPASS THE STOP MECHANISM ALLOWING IT TO SEPARATE ITSELF FROM THE BED TRACK.

title: MID BUS CORPORATION: MID BUS/HANDRAILS (2,826 affected)
summary: AN ITEM WORN BY A CHILD, SUCH AS A LONG DRAWSTRING, SASH, OR BACKPACK/BOOKBAG ACCESSORY, CAN BECOME CAUGHT IN THE AREA BETWEEN THE HANDRAIL AND THE FLOOR.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/TAKATA SEAT BELTS (84,000 affected)
summary: THE LATCH PLATE USED IN THE SEAT BELT BUCKLE WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO DESIGN DIMENSIONS.  IF THE SEAT BELT TONGUE IS INSERTED SLOWLY AT AN ANGLE INTO THE BUCKLE, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF PARTIAL ENGAGEMENT.

title: DEXTER AXLE: DEXTER/SPINDLE FAILURES (74 affected)
summary: A METALLURGICAL DEFECT IN THE AXLE SPINDLES CAUSES BRITTLENESS AND POSSIBLE BREAKAGE.

title: MAXIM TRUCK COMPANY, INC.: MAXIM/SUSPENSION (50 affected)
summary: THE EQUALIZING BEAM SHAFT OF THE TANDEM AXLE SUSPENSION WERE MANUFACTURED FROM AS-ROLLED SAE4140 STEEL RATHER THAN THE SPECIFIED ANNEALED SAE4140.  THESE SHAFTS CAN FRACTURE INSIDE THE BEAM AT THE TOE OF THE WELD.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/FMVSS 301 - FUEL TANK (400 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES BUILT ON GM P3 CUTAWAY CHASSIS.  THE SCHOOL BUS, WHEN TESTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH FMVSS NO. 301, EXCEEDED THE ALLOWABLE FUEL SPILLAGE AS SPECIFIED BY THE STANDARD.  THE FUEL TANK WAS PUNCTURED AS A RESULT OF THE IMPACT OF THE MOVING BARRIER.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/METHANOL FUEL PUMP (101 affected)
summary: THE INCORRECT ELECTRICALMOTOR WAS INSTALLED ON THE FUEL PUMP THAT SUPPLIES FUEL TO THE ENGINE.  THE MOTOR WAS SPECIFIED TO BE A CONTINUOUS DUTY MOTOR AND THE MOTORS INSTALLED WERE INTERMITTENT DUTY MOTORS.  THE INTERMITTENT DUTY MOTORS UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS WILL OVERHEAT RESULTIN IN A THERMAL SWITCH SHUT DOWN OF THE ELECTRIC MOTOR.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/BRAKES (580 affected)
summary: THE WIRING FROM THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT WAS CONNECTED TO THE WRONG WHEEL SENSOR OR TO THE WRONG BRAKE MODULATOR VALVE.  IT IS POSSIBLE THAT EITHER OR BOTH WIRING MAY HAVE OCCURRED AT EITHER THE FRONT OR REAR AXLE OR BOTH AXLES.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT (17,800 affected)
summary: THE RAIL OF THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT CAN WEAR SUFFICIENTLY SUCH THAT THE CABLE WHICH RETRACTS THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY WILL BECOME JAMMED IN THE RAIL RENDERING THE SHOULDER BELT INOPERATIVE.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/TAKATA SEAT BELTS (36,075 affected)
summary: THE LATCH PLATE USED IN THE SEAT BELT BUCKLE WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO DESIGN DIMENSIONS.  IF THE SEAT BELT TONGUE IS INSERTED SLOWLY AT AN ANGLE INTO THE BUCKLE, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF PARTIAL ENGAGEMENT.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/TAKATA SEAT BELTS (13,004 affected)
summary: THE LATCH PLATE USED IN THE SEAT BELT BUCKLE WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO DESIGN DIMENSIONS.  IF THE SEAT BELT TONGUE IS INSERTED SLOWLY AT AN ANGLE INTO THE BUCKLE, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF PARTIAL ENGAGEMENT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTO TRANSMISSION PARK PAWL (340,000 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION PARK PAWL SHAFT MAY NOT BE FREE TO ROTATE AS INTENDED.  IF THE PARK PAWL SHAFT DOES NOT ROTATE, IT WOULD PREVENT THE PARK PAWL FROM ENGAGING THE PARK GEAR WHEN THE SHIFT LEVER IS IN THE PARK POSITION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BATTERY CABLE (5,500 affected)
summary: A PLASTIC COATED STEEL SUPPORT STRAP FOR THE BATTERY CABLE WAS DAMAGED WHEN IT WAS CRIMPED ONTO THE CABLE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/STEERING (2,688 affected)
summary: THE FOUR FASTENERS THAT RETAIN THE OUTPUT SHAFT BEARING TO THE STEERING COLUMN TILT/TELESCOPING MECHANISM WAS NOT TORQUED PROPERLY.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES/HEADLAMP (28,874 affected)
summary: IF ONE OF THE HEADLAMP WIPER ARMS BECOMES MISALIGNED, THE WIPER BALDE CAN LODGE IN THE GROOVE UNDER THE HEADLAMP.  IF THE WASHERS ARE ACTIVATED WITH THE WIPER BLADE IN THE MISALIGNED AND LODGED POSITION, THE WASHER PUMP WILL RUN CONTINUOUSLY EXPELLING ALL AVAILABLE FLUID.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/POWER STEERING (194 affected)
summary: THE POWER STEERING HOSE WITH A CRIMPED END FITTING WAS IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: NEOPLAN/CNG FUEL TANK BRACKETS (202 affected)
summary: THESE BUSES ARE EQUIPPED WITH COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS FUEL TANKS SUPPLIED BY EDO CANADA.  THE FUEL CYLINDER STRAPS EXPAND WHEN TANKS ARE PRESSURIZED CAUSING BRACKETS TO BREAK THE MOUNTING HARDWARE.

title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: NEOPLAN/CNG FUEL TANKS (235 affected)
summary: THE TYPE 4 COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) FUEL TANK SUPPLIED BY EDO CANADA CAN RUPTURE DURING FUELING.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: ALTEC/TRAILERS (825 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE WIRE INSIDE THE TRAILER BRAKE WIRING PLUG WAS CONNECTED TO THE WRONG TERMINAL AND, THEREFORE, NOT PROPERLY CONNECTED TO THE SWITCH IN THE TRUCK CAB WHICH CONTROLS THE TRAILER BRAKES.

title: UNION CITY BODY COMPANY LLC: UNION CITY BODY/ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (1,496 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER POSITION.  TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR-ORION/POWER STEERING (32 affected)
summary: A LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST CAN OCCUR DUE TO THE SEPARATION OF THE PULLEY FROM THE POWER STEERING PUMP SHAFT.

title: EDO CANADA LTD.: EDO CANADA/CNG FUEL TANKS (4,824 affected)
summary: THE COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) CYLINDER MOUNTING BRACKETS RETAINING BOLTS CAN BREAK.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/OPTIMIZED IDLE SYSTEM (258 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A DETROIT DIESEL OPTIMIZED IDLE SYSTEM.  IF THE IGNITION IS TURNED ON AND THE FUSE FOR THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECM) POWER FEED LINE IS REMOVED OR BURNED OUT, THE SAFETY FEATURES DESIGNED TO PREVENT INJURY TO PERSONS WORKING IN THE VICINITY OF THE ENGINE WILL BE BYPASSED, AND  UNINTENTIONAL CRANKING OF THE ENGINE WILL OCCUR.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/MASTER CYLINDER RETAINER CLIP (1,200 affected)
summary: THE RETAINER CLIP THAT HOLDS THE MASTER CYLINDER PUSH ROD TO THE BRAKE PEDAL ARM IS MISSING.

title: Karavan Trailers, Inc.: KARAVAN/SPRING ASSEMBLY (282 affected)
summary: THE ALIGNMENT BOLT WAS NOT TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/WATER INTRUSION (20,689 affected)
summary: WATER INTRUSION INTO THE KICK PANEL AREAS IN FRONT OF BOTH THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER DOORS CAN CAUSE A CORROSION PATH BETWEEN THE BATTERY FEED AND THE ELECTRICAL GROUND.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/STEERING LINKAGE (8,340 affected)
summary: THE STEERING LINKAGE ASSEMBY CONTAINS A RELAY ROD TAPERED-STUD ATTACHMENT NUT THAT WAS NOT TORQUED TO PROPER SPECIFICATIONS.

summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER POSITION.  TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.
